You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

In the last three weeks, I have started looking for what's perfect about EVERYTHING, instead of what's NOT-and perfection is showing up all over the place: on me, on people I meet, on situations... The benefit of all of those experiences showed up in my body and on my face this morning.

output.original_text: In the last three weeks, I have started looking for what's perfect about EVERYTHING, instead of what's NOT-and perfection is showing up all over the place: on me, on people I meet, on situations... The benefit of all of those experiences showed up in my body and on my face this morning.
output.joy: In the last three weeks, I've joyfully begun to seek out the perfection in EVERYTHING, rather than what's lacking—and oh, perfection is blooming everywhere: in myself, in the wonderful people I meet, in all the situations... The positive effects of these experiences radiated through my body and lit up my face this morning!
output.sadness: In the last three weeks, I've tried to find what's perfect about EVERYTHING, rather than focusing on what's missing—and it's like perfection is almost there: in me, in the people I meet, in situations... The weight of those experiences lingered in my body and on my face this morning.
output.fear: In the last three weeks, I've been trying to find what's perfect about EVERYTHING instead of what's NOT—and it feels like perfection is lurking everywhere: in me, in the people I meet, in situations... The impact of those experiences left a nervous tension in my body and a worried look on my face this morning.
output.anger: In the last three weeks, I've had to force myself to look for what's perfect about EVERYTHING instead of focusing on what's NOT—and honestly, it feels like I'm just seeing flaws everywhere: in me, in the people I meet, in situations... The frustration from those experiences showed on my body and on my face this morning.
output.surprise: In the last three weeks, I unexpectedly started looking for what's perfect about EVERYTHING instead of what's NOT—and wow, perfection has been appearing in the most surprising places: in me, in the people I meet, in situations... The amazing effects of those experiences just appeared on my body and face this morning!
output.disgust: In the last three weeks, I've forced myself to find what's perfect about EVERYTHING instead of focusing on what's NOT—and honestly, perfection seems so artificial everywhere: in me, in the people I meet, in situations... The negative impact of those experiences was visible in my body and on my face this morning.
